units.source_text: 玉鬘的侍女们都称赞兵部卿亲王仪容之优美，说他相貌很像源氏太政大臣。

en.t: Tamakazura's serving women all praised the graceful beauty of Prince Hyobukyo's appearance, saying that his looks greatly resembled Genji, the Grand Minister.

units.source_text: 她们不知道源氏的用心，都说他昨夜照顾之周到，正像母亲一样，其深情厚谊，甚可感谢。

en.t: Not knowing Genji's true intentions, they all said that his care the previous night had been so attentive, just like a mother's, and that such deep kindness was truly something to be grateful for.

units.source_text: 玉鬘看见源氏为她如此不惮烦劳，心中想道：“都是我自己命苦之故。

en.t: Seeing Genji spare himself no trouble for her sake, Tamakazura thought to herself, "It is all because my own fate is so unfortunate.

units.source_text: 如果真的父亲找到了我，我成了一个世间普通儿女之身，那时我领受源氏太政大臣的爱情，有何不可呢？

en.t: If my real father had found me, and I had become an ordinary daughter in the eyes of the world, what would be wrong then with accepting the love of Genji, the Grand Minister?

units.source_text: 只因我这身世与常人不同，就不得不顾虑世人讥评。”

en.t: Only because my circumstances are different from other people's must I worry about the world's criticism."
She pondered this day and night, overwhelmed by grief and distress.

units.source_text: 然而源氏实在也不肯胡行乱为，使她受到委屈。

en.t: Yet Genji truly was unwilling to act recklessly and improperly, or to cause her to suffer humiliation.

units.source_text: 他只是一向有这个习癖，即使对于秋好皇后，也不见得全是纯洁的父亲之爱。

en.t: It was simply that he had always had this habit; even toward Empress Akikonomu, his feeling could not be said to have been entirely pure fatherly love.

units.source_text: 每逢机会，不良之心也会萌动起来。

en.t: Whenever an opportunity arose, improper thoughts would begin to stir in him as well.

units.source_text: 只因皇后身份尊贵，高不可攀，所以他不敢公然表示，只得独自在心中烦恼。

en.t: Only because the Empress's rank was so exalted and beyond his reach did he not dare reveal it openly, and could only suffer alone in his heart.

units.source_text: 至于这个玉鬘呢，性情温和可亲，样子又很时髦，他的恋慕之情自然难于抑制。

en.t: As for Tamakazura, her nature was gentle and approachable, and her appearance was also very fashionable, so his longing for her was naturally hard to restrain.

units.source_text: 有时不免对她做些教人见了怀疑的举动。

en.t: At times he could not help behaving toward her in ways that would make anyone who saw them suspicious.

units.source_text: 幸而立刻后悔，终于保住了纯洁的关系。

en.t: Fortunately, he would immediately regret it, and in the end their pure relationship was preserved.
